name: wscan-library
description: Nuclei templates + Nmap NSE scripts + categories index for wscan

msf-scanner.note: HTTP/SMB MSF scanners are not codegen'd — covered by nuclei + NSE

vendor-cve-version-checks.detection: HTTP GET, potential version match only

kyocera-check.mode: GET WSDL only; no export or credential extraction

bitrix-path-disclosure-fix.note: Require PHP diagnostic with absolute Bitrix PHP path and line number; generic error text no longer matches.

winrm-network-audit.method: Unauthenticated POST /wsman; HTTP challenge advertisement only
winrm-network-audit.verification: Offline index generation and application build; no target execution

database-access-audit.native: PostgreSQL/MySQL/MSSQL/Redis credentials, sequential NSE driver adapter for MongoDB/Cassandra/Informix/Oracle
database-access-audit.verification: Local mock protocol servers and offline index generation; no real targets

layout.tools/refresh_msf_scanner.sh: Regen msf-scanner + categories when MSF is present
layout.products.json: Products, service constraints, requirements, evidence and complete source inventory
layout.tools/gen_products.py: Regenerate product index and coverage report
layout.security/product-rules.json: Reviewed aliases, bindings and category overrides

catalog_scope.excluded_sources: retained in source tree and products.inventory; not executable catalogue entries
catalog_scope.application_requirement: Only execute selected catalogue entries; never recursively run source directories

features: MSSQL TDS PRELOGIN / SQL and Windows NTLM authentication
persistent MSSQL SQL console and fixed read-only audits
NSE InitScript declarations and selected-service scope
read-only SMB guest/null/credential browser and masked config search
bounded Web LFI / virtual host check
application_integration.verification: Go build and offline index generation only; no tests or target execution
application_integration.engine_support: per-method implementation described in report; native NSE target compatibility unverified
